description:
Create a new portfolio called 'DCA Strategy' in JStock and record four separate buy transactions for Meta Platforms (META) to simulate a dollar-cost averaging strategy. 

1. Create a new portfolio named 'DCA Strategy'.
2. Switch to this portfolio and record the following 4 buy transactions (ensure the Broker Fee is set to 4.95 for each):
   - Nov 15, 2023: 10 units at $332.40
   - Dec 15, 2023: 10 units at $353.96
   - Jan 15, 2024: 10 units at $370.17
   - Feb 15, 2024: 10 units at $473.28
3. Save the portfolio (File > Save).
4. Create a summary file at '/home/ga/dca_summary.txt' that lists:
   - Total units purchased
   - Total purchase value (before fees)
   - Total brokerage fees paid
   - Net total cost (purchase value + fees)
   - Weighted average cost per share (net total / units)
